answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, so mass registration becomes expensive. Sybil resistance can work like a reef: each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root, and every new identity costs a fresh stake plus a slow attestation period. Reputation then accrues like yarrow taking root, while cheap throwaway accounts drift away like sand on a dune, unable to earn trust or rewards. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
